title: Ion-trap hardware calibration schema
description: Schema for ion-trap hardware calibration data for ARBITER QDS verification

device_id.description: Unique identifier for the hardware device

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when calibration was measured

qubit_count.description: Total number of qubits in the device

spam_error.description: State preparation and measurement (SPAM) error probability

t2_seconds.description: Coherence time T2 (dephasing timescale) in seconds

t1_seconds.description: Relaxation time T1 (amplitude damping timescale) in seconds

link_idle_seconds.description: Typical idle time between entangling operations

heating_error_per_link.description: Residual two-qubit error from motional heating per link

single_qubit_gates_per_round.description: Typical number of single-qubit gates per QDS protocol round

ms_overrotation_rad.description: Systematic MS gate phase error (over-rotation) in radians

attacker_storage_seconds.description: Storage time for replay attacker's quantum memory

notes.description: Free-form notes about calibration (measurement conditions, caveats, provenance)
